ios.desc:
Generate custom stories for your kids using AI!

Storytime AI lets you generate unique, personalized stories to your kid's liking! You can adjust settings for age-appropriateness, story length, or to include your kid’s name in the story. You can then write your own prompts to direct the AI's storytelling (or easily use provided story themes). Also available in multiple languages, including Spanish, Chinese, German, and many more!

quotes.text: For months, my wife and I were manually and haphazardly using ChatGPT to generate bedtime stories for our 3-year-old (mostly using her ideas as prompts), so I built this app on top of the ChatGPT API to make bedtime a lot easier.
